landing.heroTitle: Upload a script. Get the production and equipment sheet.
landing.heroBody: Sinemai AI breaks your screenplay or ad brief down scene by scene, then recommends the camera, lighting and grip package, the cinematographers whose work matches your look, the rental houses that actually stock the gear, and what it will cost.
landing.step1Body: Fountain, Final Draft, PDF or pasted scenes. Pick your visual style and budget tier.
landing.step2Body: A team of specialist agents reads every scene: lighting complexity, camera movement, day or night, special requirements.
landing.step3Body: Camera, lens, lighting and grip recommendations drawn from a curated catalog — never invented.
landing.step4Body: Cinematographers matched by visual style, vendors matched by real stock, and a budget built from real day rates.
landing.trustBody: Every piece of equipment, every rental price and every cinematographer on your sheet comes from a database query, not from a language model's memory. A reviewer agent checks the finished sheet for budget-tier violations, weak matches and contradictions before you ever see it.
landing.trustPoint1: Equipment comes from a curated catalog query, never model memory.
landing.trustPoint2: Rental prices come from the vendor who owns the gear.
landing.trustPoint3: Crew costs come from an admin-maintained rate table.
landing.trustPoint4: A reviewer agent blocks a sheet that would mislead a spending decision.
landing.closingBody: Upload a screenplay or an ad brief and see the breakdown, the package, the people and the number in a few minutes.

schedule.title: Shooting schedule
schedule.subtitle: A first pass grouped by location and call, built from the scene hours.
schedule.note: Derived from the breakdown, not fixed: change a scene and the schedule follows. Locations are grouped so the unit moves as little as possible, and day and night calls are never mixed.
